verdict.rationale: Recurly's Dunning Management controls which emails are sent, when retries occur, and what happens if a subscriber never pays. Professional and Elite plans can run up to 50 targeted dunning campaigns, and Recurly Engage adds in-app payment-failure prompts. A community comparison also notes that dunning emails are automated without needing webhooks. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of email branding/template customization, explicitly configurable grace periods, specific cancel-vs-unpaid final-state options, in-app prompts sitting in the core dunning product rather than the separate Engage product, and hands-on corroboration.
